title: festuca ovina subsp. valentina
intro: Festuca ovina subsp. valentina, commonly known as Valencian sheep's fescue, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca ovina subsp. valentina include modulating the immune system, reducing oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include phenolic compounds, saponins, and essential oils, which have been identified in its leaves and roots.
